panels.title: Issues received (24h)
panels.description: GitHub issues filed on the fork in the last 24 hours that the autopilot ingested.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM issues WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Devin sessions running now
panels.description: Sessions currently executing on Devin. Capped by DEVIN_MAX_CONCURRENT in .env (default 3).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM devin_sessions WHERE state IN ('dispatched','running')

panels.title: PRs opened (24h)
panels.description: Pull requests Devin opened on the fork in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pull_requests WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Devin spend today (ACU)
panels.description: ACU = Agent Compute Unit, Devin's billing metric. Pulled live from Devin's /consumption/daily API.

panels.title: Auto-fix success rate (24h)
panels.description: Of sessions dispatched in the last 24h, the % that reached 'completed' (PR opened).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN state = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) END FROM devin_sessions WHERE dispatched_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: All Devin sessions
panels.description: Every session the autopilot has dispatched. Running rows sit at the top (newest first); completed and failed history is below. ACU/$ for running sessions tick upward live; for completed sessions they're the final billed amount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ds.devin_session_id AS "Devin session", i.github_number AS "Issue #", left(i.title, 60) AS "Title", ds.state AS "State", ds.acu_consumed AS "ACU", ds.cost_usd AS "$", ds.dispatched_at AS "Dispatched", ds.completed_at AS "Completed", pr.github_pr_number AS "PR #", pr.html_url AS "PR URL" FROM devin_sessions ds JOIN issues i ON i.id = ds.issue_id LEFT JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.session_id = ds.id ORDER BY CASE WHEN ds.state IN ('dispatched','running') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ds.dispatched_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent issues
panels.description: Every GitHub issue the autopilot ingested. 'Dup of' = flagged as a near-duplicate of that earlier issue (so Devin never sees them twice).

targets.rawSql: SELECT github_number AS "Issue #", left(title, 60) AS "Title", status AS "Status", dedup_of_id AS "Dup of", html_url AS "URL", created_at AS "Filed" FROM issues ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Pull requests Devin opened
panels.description: Click any URL to open the PR on GitHub.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pr.github_pr_number AS "PR #", pr.merge_state AS "State", pr.html_url AS "URL", pr.created_at AS "Opened" FROM pull_requests pr ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Backlog burndown
panels.description: Running totals over time: issues filed (top line) vs. PRs Devin has opened (bottom line). The gap between them is the open backlog.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('minute', created_at)) AS "Issues filed" FROM issues ORDER BY time
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('minute', created_at)) AS "PRs opened" FROM pull_requests ORDER BY time
